- Avg prompt length: ~120 tokens; we expect some longer documents up to 1k tokens for a subset of jobs
- Preferred model family: Llama-r/equivalent; we have some internal fine-tuned variants

The Wed 2026-09-01 15:00 CEST slot would work best for us — can we do that? If needed, I can share a CSV export of recent traffic patterns.
